chain_trace.break_detail: Chain broken at doc: No documented behavioral contract for hnsw_ef range validation at search time. Contract only specifies vector dimension constraint (qdrant_type_search_points_001), not parameter validation. Zero value accepted despite being logically invalid for beam search.

source_grounding.call_chain_traced: SearchParams definition (types.rs) → no validation attribute on hnsw_ef field → CollectionParams.search_max_hnsw_ef optional cap (not enforced by default) → API accepts any usize value including 0

mundane_explanation.surviving: Zero hnsw_ef accepted by design (documented as Option<usize> with no minimum), but logically meaningless for beam search - should have minimum validation (ef >= 1)
